scope_summary.value: Renovation of a 17,000 SF unit within Building 364 to convert a former 'Locked Inpatient Psychiatry STAR Unit' into a new Mental Health Residential Rehabilitation Treatment Program (RRTP) — a less restrictive, more recovery-oriented, residential-style environment for Veterans. Scope includes interior finish replacement (LVT flooring, acoustic ceilings, paint, tile), conversion of saloon-style bathroom doors to standard hardware, replacement of anti-ligature plumbing fixtures with commercial hotel-type fixtures, conversion of North-wing bedrooms to offices and group meeting rooms, demolition and rebuild of the Nurses' Station as an open four-workstation design with maintained line-of-sight to wings and Day Room/Recreation Area, conversion of Tub Room A147 to a Urine Sampling room, and installation of patient code access locks, monitored exit devices, and CCTV monitored at the Nurses' Station.

design_codes_and_standards.value: IBC 2015 (ICC); NFPA 101 Life Safety Code 2015; ABAAS (Architectural Barriers Act Accessibility Standards May 2006); VA Technical Information Library (TIL) — specifically the VA Mental Health Design Guide Standards
